post.description: Links an existing funding account to the specified brokerage account. The request is safe to retry: if the funding account is already linked to the brokerage account, the existing bank link is returned with a 200 instead of a 201. A brokerage account can hold a limited number of active bank links; exceeding it returns 409 and the caller must delete an existing link before adding another.

post.summary: Set beneficiary allocations for an account draft
post.description:
Atomically sets allocation percentages for beneficiaries on the specified account draft. This endpoint only updates allocation percentages — no other beneficiary fields (name, address, relationship, etc.) can be changed through it. Use PUT .../beneficiaries/{beneficiaryId} to update other fields.

Validation rules:
- Every beneficiary in a designation group (Primary or Contingent) must be included when any beneficiary of that group is present.
- Percentages must sum to exactly 100 per designation group.
- Each percentage must be strictly greater than 0 and at most 100, with at most 2 decimal places.
- No duplicate beneficiaryIds are allowed.

400.description: Invalid input: allocations do not sum to 100 per designation group, duplicate beneficiaryIds, missing beneficiaries within a designation group, percentage out of range or exceeds 2 decimal places, or account type does not support beneficiaries

403.description: Access denied - caller lacks READ on the household

404.description: Draft, bundle, or household not found

post.description: Creates a new Account Group (repcode). The caller must be an advisor in the organization.

403.description: Access denied — caller is not an advisor in the organization

delete.description: Deletes a household. The household must have no accounts assigned and no billing schedules before deletion can proceed; member accounts must be unassigned by the partner first, after which they become unassigned. The caller must be an advisor in the organization with access on the household.

403.description: Access denied: caller is not an advisor in the organization or lacks access on the household

404.description: Household not found in the organization

409.description: Household has accounts or a billing schedule still assigned and cannot be deleted

patch.description: Updates the name of an existing household. The caller must be an advisor in the organization with access on the household. Note: `name` is required — this endpoint behaves like a PUT for the name field, not a partial update.

400.description: Invalid input — name is missing or blank

403.description: Access denied — caller is not an advisor in the organization or lacks access on the household

404.description: Household not found in the organization

get.summary: Get a financial account by id
get.description: Returns the detail for a single financial account in the organization. The caller must be an advisor in the organization. Returns 404 if the account does not exist or belongs to a different organization.

403.description: Access denied — caller is not an advisor in the organization

404.description: Account not found in the organization, or caller has no access

patch.description: Updates patchable properties on a financial account. In v1 only the status field is patchable: set to ARCHIVED to archive or ACTIVE to unarchive. Both transitions are idempotent. Archiving an account that is currently assigned to a household is rejected (422); callers must unassign the account from the household before archiving. The caller must be an advisor in the organization.

400.description: Invalid input: empty body, missing status, or unsupported status value (only ARCHIVED and ACTIVE are accepted)

403.description: Access denied: caller is not an advisor in the organization

404.description: Account not found in the organization, or caller has no access

422.description: Cannot archive an account that is currently assigned to a household; unassign it first

get.summary: List funding-eligible accounts
get.description: Returns the brokerage accounts belonging to the end client that are eligible to receive ACH funding. Call this before presenting the account-selection step of a deposit or bank-linking flow. Eligibility (active Altruist-custodied brokerage accounts) is determined by the upstream service; ERA applies no filtering of its own.

get.summary: List bank links for a funding account
get.description: Returns all active bank links for the specified funding account. The funding account must belong to the specified user; if it does not, or the user does not exist, the request is rejected with 404.

404.description: User not found, or the funding account does not belong to the user

400.description: Invalid input — page or size is out of range

403.description: Access denied — caller does not have view access to the organization

delete.summary: Remove an account from a household
delete.description: Unassigns the account from the household. The account is moved to the org's internal unassigned pool; it is not deleted or archived. The first DELETE returns 204. Repeating the DELETE on an account no longer in this household returns 404 (code 1100).

403.description: Access denied — caller does not have access to this household

404.description: Household not found, or the account is not currently in this household (including a repeat DELETE after the account was already unassigned).

422.description: Account has a manual fee allocation > 0%; reset to zero before removing

delete.description: Cancels a pending cash transfer (soft delete)

400.description: Cash transfer ... is not in pending state.

code.description:
### Error Codes

| Code   | Description                         |
|--------|-------------------------------------|
| **0xx** | **Unknown or Unexpected**          |
| 0    | Unknown error                         |
| 40   | Unknown authentication error          |
| **1xx** | **General**                        |
| 101  | Invalid input                         |
| 104  | Not found                             |
| 140  | Access Denied                         |
| 141  | Unauthorized                          |
| 150  | Not implemented                       |
| **10xx** | **Household**                     |
| 1000 | Household not found                   |
| 1001 | Duplicate contact                     |
| 1002 | Household contact not found           |
| 1003 | Household contact already exists      |
| **11xx** | **Account**                       |
| 1100 | Account not found                     |
| 1110 | Invalid account group                 |
| **12xx** | **User**                          |
| 1200 | User not found                        |
| 1201 | User profile not found                |
| **13xx** | **Transfer**                      |
| 1300 | Transfer not found                    |
| 1301 | Transfer not supported                |
| 1302 | Duplicate transfer                    |
| 1303 | Funding account not found             |
| 1304 | Duplicate funding account             |
| **14xx** | **Client Agreement**              |
| 1400 | Client Agreement not found            |
| 1401 | Invalid Client Agreement file         |
| 1402 | Client Agreement could not be updated |
| **15xx** | **Trusted Contact**               |
| 1500 | Trusted Contact not found             |
| **17xx** | **Cash Set Aside**                |
| 1700 | Cash set aside not found              |
| 1701 | Cash set aside invalid amount         |
| 1702 | Cash set aside invalid date           |
| 1703 | Cash set aside upstream error         |
| 1704 | Cash set aside cannot be cancelled    |
| 1705 | Cash set aside invalid account        |
| **18xx** | **Cash Settings**                 |
| 1800 | Cash settings not found               |

CreateScheduledTransferRequestV1.description: Request to create a scheduled transfer for a brokerage account

fundingAccountId.description: The financial account UUID for the account that funds will be deposited into or withdrawn from, depending on the direction field value

direction.description: Indicates whether the scheduled transfer is a deposit or withdrawal

frequency.description: The interval for the scheduled transfer to occur between the start and end dates. Once: a one-time transfer. Daily: every day. Weekly: every week. EveryTwoWeeks: every two weeks. Monthly: every month. EveryTwoMonths: every two months. Quarterly: every three months. SemiAnnually: every six months. Annually: every twelve months.

amount.description: The amount for the transfer in USD

startDate.description: The first date on which the scheduled transfer should occur

endDate.description: The last potential date a scheduled transfer will occur, depending on the interval. This should not be set for one-time scheduled transfers.

isAutomatedRmd.description: Indicates that this schedule has opted the account into an automatic required minimum distribution payment. The amount will be calculated per internal rules and this schedule cannot be modified.

iraContribution.description: IRA contribution details. Present only for deposit transfers.

iraDistribution.description: IRA distribution details. Present only for withdrawal transfers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the scheduled transfer

status.description: This field cannot be modified by the user.

createdByUserId.description: This field cannot be modified by the user.

designationType.description: Designation type for the beneficiary. PerStirpes is only valid for Primary designation with Spouse or NonSpouse relationship. Entity beneficiaries and Contingent beneficiaries must use PerCapita.

BeneficiaryAllocationV1.description: A single beneficiary allocation entry pairing a beneficiary with a percentage.

beneficiaryId.description: ID of an existing beneficiary on the account draft.

percentage.description: Allocation percentage for this beneficiary. Must be strictly greater than 0 and at most 100, with at most 2 decimal places. Percentages for all beneficiaries within a designation group (Primary or Contingent) must sum to exactly 100.

SetBeneficiaryAllocationsRequestV1.description: Request to set allocation percentages for existing beneficiaries on an account draft. This endpoint only updates allocation percentages — no other beneficiary fields can be changed through it. All beneficiaries within a designation group (Primary or Contingent) must be included when any beneficiary of that group is present, and percentages must sum to exactly 100 per group.

allocations.description: List of beneficiary allocation entries. Must not be empty. Each entry pairs an existing beneficiaryId with a percentage. No duplicate beneficiaryIds are allowed. All beneficiaries sharing the same designation (Primary or Contingent) must be included if any one of them is, and their percentages must sum to 100.

ScheduledTransferV1.description: A scheduled transfer associated with a brokerage account

id.description: The unique UUID identifier for the scheduled transfer

fundingAccountId.description: The financial account UUID for the account that funds will be deposited into or withdrawn from, depending on the direction field value

status.description: The status of the scheduled transfer. Active: the transfer is scheduled and will occur on the next transfer date. Inactive: the transfer is paused and will not occur until reactivated. Canceled: the transfer has been canceled and will not occur. Complete: the transfer has finished all scheduled occurrences.

direction.description: Indicates whether the scheduled transfer is a deposit or withdrawal

amount.description: The amount for the transfer in USD

startDate.description: The first date on which the scheduled transfer should occur

endDate.description: The last potential date a scheduled transfer will occur, depending on the interval. This should not be set for one-time scheduled transfers.

nextTransferDate.description: The next date on which the scheduled transfer will occur

isAutomatedRmd.description: Indicates that this schedule has opted the account into an automatic required minimum distribution payment. The amount will be calculated per internal rules and this schedule cannot be modified.

frequency.description: The interval for the scheduled transfer to occur between the start and end dates. Once: a one-time transfer. Daily: every day. Weekly: every week. EveryTwoWeeks: every two weeks. Monthly: every month. EveryTwoMonths: every two months. Quarterly: every three months. SemiAnnually: every six months. Annually: every twelve months.

iraDistribution.description: IRA distribution details. Present only for withdrawal transfers.
